rapport_notes: Professional and patient walking through a detailed room-by-room inventory on a fairly technical multi-day pack-and-move quote.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: we will only bill you, okay by the end of the move for the actual hours render... if everything will be done in just eleven hours then you will only be paying for that eleven hours.

top_strength: Made a clear, direct explicit ask for the booking ('would you like to go ahead and reserve your schedule') even on a complex two-day pack-and-move quote, rather than letting the call fade out passively.
coaching_note: Never asked the biggest-concerns agenda question across a nearly 17-minute detailed inventory call — an easy structural piece to add before diving into room-by-room logistics.
